notes.title: Full Release of Coloring Game: Studio
notes.notes:
Coloring Game: Studio is out of Early Access.

You have access to 150 pictures (3,600,000 px). 
Ability to upload and edit pictures.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231040/Coloring_Game_Studio/

notes.title: Update 2.5.2
notes.notes:
Added the ability to select colors via Numpad;
Changed the way you select color on the keyboard.
Now, to select a color with an index greater than 9, you do not need to hold down Shift; it is enough to click on the next digit in the number set within two seconds.

For example, to select a color with serial number 56, you first need to press 5 (color number 5 will be activated), and then press 6 within two seconds.

notes.title: Update 2.5.0
notes.notes:
A major Coloring Game 2 update has arrived. This update will not appear in other games of the CG series.

The game core which is responsible for the visualization of the working area has been redesigned completely. 
Data buffering optimization has allowed reducing the use of RAM more than twice. The speed of switching between the colors has increased several times. The overall performance has improved.

The saving mechanism has been changed. 
The saving mechanism was originally developed for the base game and worked perfectly well with the image sizes that are used in most CG games. With the arrival of CG2, players were given an opportunity to upload their own images, and the program now had to work with dozens of times bigger images comparing to the base game. As a result, when trying to save large images, the app used to get blocked, and users perceived it as an input lag. 

Now, however, the saving mechanism is divided into three stages (data formation, data analysis, compression). After each stage is completed, control is passed to the main program which performs user actions.  This allows either eliminating the input lag problem or considerably reducing this side effect.

Now you can unlock FPS.
To unlock FPS, you need to add the line to the config.json file:
[code]"fps_unlock":true[/code]

Note: during the two months that I spent working on this update I’ve tried to identify as many errors as possible. Unfortunately, the size of the changes introduced to the game code increases the risk of errors which I could have overlooked. I hope for your understanding and kindly ask you to report errors not in the comments below the news but in a separate discussion thread.


Do not forget that very soon the release of Coloring Game: Girls

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1290880/Coloring_Game_Girls/

notes.title: Announcement of the Update 2.2
notes.notes:
On June 5 (UPD: June 12) the last 2020 major update for CG2 is going to take place. 

Bonus levels in DE

15 new images are going to be added to the DLC (~3 mln. px). The bonus levels will be non-animated and will feature no achievements.
 
8K support

Initially I didn’t expect much demand for the import of large images but, from now on, images in 8K UHD resolution (7680x4320, 33,177,600px.) are going to be supported as well.

Optimization:

- Due to the use of multi-level caching, the stability of moving the working area by the arrow keys has been improved.
- To avoid delays during autosaves, the game is now going to be saved during 5-second idle.
- Better interaction with Steam Overlay.

Steam Cloud

- Fully-fledged support of the import and export of images in Steam Cloud (210 cells for saving).
- Opportunity to store images and save files both locally and in the cloud. The total number of cells for user images has been increased to 330 (120 local cells + 210 cells in the cloud).

Time counter

Players are now able to keep track of the time they spend on coloring user images. The best times are going to be registered and saved.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457745/7a544d9f4ad240daebefc5eb93306786e0819404.gif

notes.title: Big Update 2.1
notes.notes:
I’m delighted to announce a major update to the Coloring Game 2. 
The update concerns both the base game and the Deluxe Edition. 

The maximum number of colors in imported images has been increased to 99, and the color palette panel has been slightly modified.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457745/c8c44ce08043fc7541f474427cd31202d2df17be.gif


Besides, the full-screen mode for the Navigator panel has been added (HotKey - M). Together with the Hint mode it will enable you to better visualize uncolored pixels.

Finally, the fullscreen mode button for the workspace has been introduced (HotKey - F).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457745/e558156433e5e62da7ec1eb223d4c8c0d785cded.gif

For the overlay to work correctly, I have increased the FPS to 20 (by default).
